structure_proposals.why: Legs A asks for four sets of leg curl and you have never once done four — three on 26 July, three on 2 August, three on 20 August and two on 13 September — so this writes the ask as three sets, the number you actually run and the same number Legs B already asks for.

The Bulgarian split squat asks for three sets and you stopped at two on 26 July, two on 2 August and two again on 13 September — only 20 August got three — so this makes the written ask two sets, the same fix you took on the rope pushdown, the incline curl and the reverse pec deck.
